Abdominal ultrasound revealed subcapsular hepatic bleeding

response.rationale: Hepatic adenoma is strongly supported by prior histologic proof and the classic complication of spontaneous subcapsular bleeding; the HCC suspicion is only speculative and lacks typical imaging features or tumor marker elevation.

rejected.why: Only a clinical suspicion of atypical HCC is mentioned, without supporting histology or typical features; the prior biopsy showed adenoma without malignancy.
